summary: This is not a town plaza; it is one grey Plastic slab. The brief asked for a monument, lamp posts, benches, planters and a sign, and none of them appear in any of the three views. There is no focal point, no material language, no detail of any kind. A player would have no reason to stand here because there is nothing here. Start over from the object list and build each piece with real proportions,
hardFails: only one material used (Plastic) — a scene needs a material language, not one surface everywhere
over 90% of parts are default Plastic — no material pass was done
